Brunno Pastro Xavier de Oliveira
I am a PhD student in Economics at Insper Institute of Education and Research, where I am advised by Marco Bonomo and Miguel Bandeira.
My fields are monetary economics, applied macroeconometrics, and finance, with a particular interest in central bank communication.
Before Insper, I earned a BSc in Economics from the University of São Paulo (USP).
